description: This source file defines the MediaPackageV2Client class which extends the AWS SDK's AwsClient class. It provides method signatures for various asynchronous and synchronous operations related to the AWS Elemental MediaPackage V2 service, such as creating, deleting, and retrieving channels, origin endpoints, and policies.

classes.name: MediaPackageV2Client
